verdict.rationale: QuickBooks does expose journal-entry CRUD via its official API/MCP server (29 entity types with full CRUD and write-safety toggles like QUICKBOOKS_DISABLE_WRITE), so an agent could draft and post entries programmatically, and accountants can be given direct book access. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated 'review queue' or draft/pending-approval state for journal entries awaiting accountant sign-off before posting. Missing for 10: documented draft/pending status for journal entries, an approval workflow tying agent-created entries to accountant review, and any UI/API concept of a review queue.
